title: Advanced Optimization Strategies
learning_outcomes: Explain advanced optimization strategies and accurately refer to at least two syllabus subtopics.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study advanced optimization strategies in the context of model evaluation and optimization. You will connect the PDF subtopics to a small example and practice describing what the evidence does—and does not—support.
content.why_it_matters: Advanced Optimization Strategies matters because it affects how data is collected, represented, analyzed, interpreted, or used in a decision. Check the task and assumptions before choosing a method.

content_blocks.title: Common mistakes and fixes
content_blocks.text: Keep the question, data grain, units, and assumptions explicit. If a result differs, inspect the input and steps in order. Avoid turning an observed association into a causal claim, treating a sample as the population, or assuming a small demonstration guarantees production behavior. A monitoring metric should have a denominator, a time window, and a defined response.

hints: Write down the input, expected result, units, and assumptions first.
